fusions.name: Locked Horns
fusions.desc: A head-on butt that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ledge Shove
fusions.desc: Heaves every enemy within 2.5 tiles aside, dealing 14 damage and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rooted Stance
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6%.
